content: Galba Bolla Keziza Iita Hargefe Geeyza Woga
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Issaadey asateththa bolla diza iita galba hargefe paxidaappe guye geesho wogay hayssafe kaallizayssa; izi geesh gididayssa izaades yootettiza gallas hessaadey qeesekko baana mala izas yootetto.
He izas yootettida qeesezi asi dizasoppe gede haraso kessidi baakko yidayssa lo7eththi xeello; izaadey hargezappe paxidaa gidikko,
qeesezi paxa diza nam7u geeshsha kafotanne ziga mith, zo7o xilata, hisophphe miththa hayth gujji ekki yaana mala azazo.
Hessafe guye qeesezi kafotappe issaa pultto haaththi izan diza guuqa kere bolla shukettana mala azazo.
Hankko paxa diza kafoza efidi ziga miththara, zo7o xilataranne hisophphe miththa bonccora issife gaththi kase shukettida kafoza suuththan gelththi kesso.

Suuththaaka asateththa bolla diza galba hargefe paxizaade bolla laappunto wuxxo; hessafe guye izi geesh gididayssa iza eriso; hankko paxa diza kafozakka gede haraso kessidi demban piradhdhana mala yeddo.

«Iita galba hargefe paxidaadey ba may7o meecco; ba bolla diza iske ubbaa meedetto; ba bollaka meecetto; wogay giza mala izi geesh gidana; hessafe guye asi dizaso gelanaas dandayees; gido attiin laappun gallas gakkanaas izi ba dunkaanaappe karen de7o.

Laappunththo gallas qasseka ba hu7e, ba buuchchinne ba deemo, hara awanka ba asateththa bolla diza iske ubbaa meedetto; ba may7o haaththan meecconne ba bollaka meecetto; hessafe guye izi geesh gidana.

«Osppunththa gallas issi wosoykka istta bolla baynda nam7u dorsa laaqqatanne issi layththa uzzo eho; kaththa yarsho gishshas wogara miththa zayten munuqettida heedzdzu kilo dhiillenne issi litiro zaytes heedzdzanththo kushe wogara miththa zayte eho.
Qeesezikka addezi izi ehida ubbaara issi bolla Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza pengen GODAA sinth shiishsho.

«Hessafe guye nam7u qeeri dharshotappe issaa ekkidi issi litiros heedzdzanththo kushe gidiza wogara zaytera issife gaththi ekkidi qoho gishshas shiiqiza yarsho histti shiishsho; qeesezi he yarshozakka yaanne haa qaaseththiza yarsho histti GODAA sinththan qaaseththi shiishsho.
Laaqqazakka nagara yarshossinne xuugettiza yarshos shukkiza geeshshasohon shukko; gaasoykka qoho gishshas yarshoy nagara wursanaas shiiqiza yarsho mala qeesezas gisha gidana; izikka keehi dumma.
Qeesezi qoho yarshos shiiqiza suuththafe guuththara ekkidi he geeyzaades ushachcha hayththa xeera izas ushachcha kushe manththa biradhdhenne ushachcha toho manththa biradhdhe tiyo.
Qeesezi wogara miththa zaytezappe guuththara ekkidi ba hadirsa kushe qaa7an tigo.
Ba ushachcha kushe xeeran guuththara ekkidi Xoossa sinththan laappunto wuxxo.
Ba kushe qaa7an attida zaytezappe guuththara ekkidi geeyzaades ushachcha hayththa xeera, ushachcha kushe manththa biradhdhenne ushachcha toho manththa biradhdhe tiyo.
Ba kushe qaa7an attida zaytezakka geeyzaade hu7en gusso; qeesey izaade nagara geeshsho.
«Hessafe guye qeesezi ba tunateththafe geeyzaade nagara wursanaas shiiqida mehe shukko.
Qasseka qeesezi he xuugettiza yarshoza kaththa yarshozara issife yarsho yarshizasoza bolla woththidi xuuggo; hessa mala ooson izaade nagarappe maarisees; izaadeyka geesh gidees.

«Izaadey hessa ubbaa ehanaas dandayontta manqo gidikko Godaa sinththan yaanne haa qaaseththidi ba nagara wursanaas issi dharsho laaqqa ehidi qoho yarsho gishshas shiishsho; qasse kaththa yarshozaska wogara miththa zayten munuqettida issi kilo liiqo dhiille kaththa yarshos eho; hessaththoka issi litiros heedzdzanththo kushe gidiza zayte eho.
Qasseka iza wolqqay dandayda mala nam7u haraphpheta woykko nam7u waanosetappe issaa nagara gishshas yarshos, nam7anththoza qasse xuugettiza yarshos eho.
«Geesho wogay polettiza osppunththa gallas heyta ubbaa ehidi Gaytoteththa Dunkaane pengen GODAA sinththan qeeses immo.
Qeesezikka qoho yarshos shiiqiza dorsa laaqqanne wogara miththa zayteza ekkidi yaanne haa qaaseththiza yarsho ooththi GODAA sinththan yarsho.

Qoho gishshas shiiqiza yarshos shiiqida dorsa laaqqa shukko; suuththaafe guuththara ekkidi geeyzaades ushachcha kushe manththa biradhdhe, ushachcha toho manththa biradhdhenne ushachcha hayththa xeera tiyo.
Qeesezi zaytezappe guuththara ba hadirsa kushe qaa7an tigo.
Ba ushachcha kushe biradhdhen guuththara bochchidi Xoossa sinththan laappunto wuxxo.

Ba kushe qaa7an tigida zayteppe guuththara ekkidi qoho yarsho suuththan bochchidaason hessika geeyzaades ushachcha hayththa xeera, ushachcha kushe manththa biradhdhe xeera, ushachcha toho manththa biradhdhe xeera boshiso.
Qeesezi ba kushen attida zayteza addeza hu7en gusso; hessaththo ooththidi geesho woga GODAA sinththan polo.
Hessafe guye haraphpheta woykko waanoseta geeyzaade wolqqay gaththida keena qeesezi yarsho.
Heytanttafe issaa nagaras shiiqiza yarshos nam7anththoza qasse xuugettiza yarshos kaththa yarshora gaththi shiishsho; qeesezi ubbaaka hayssa malan geeyzaade nagarappe geeshsho.
Asappe gede hara asan aadhdhiza iita galba hargefe geeyanaas koshshiza woga polanaas dandayontta manqo asas diza wogay hayssa» gides.
Buuqay Beettida Keeth Geesho Woga
GODAY Musessinne Aaroones hizgides,
«Tani inttes immiza Kanaane biitta intte geliza wode issi keeththan tani buuqa yeggiko,
he keeththaadey biidi qeeseza, ‹Tason ay iita hargey dizaakko› giidi yooto.
Soon diza miish ubbay tuna geetettontta mala qeesezi he iita hargaa beyanaas gelanaappe kasetidi soon diza miish ubbaa kare kessana mala azazo; hessafe guye qeesezi xeellanaas keeththaa giddo gelo.
Hargeza lo7eththi paacci xeelliza wode keeththaa lukki lukki miza hargezas medhay maata mala cilila woykko zo7o woykko puncarka misati beettiko,
qeesezi he keeththaafe kezidi keeththay laappun gallas gakkanaas gordettana mala ooththo.
Qeesezi laappunththa gallas simmidi qasseka xeello; hargezi kaseppe gede dari dari biikko,
hargey istta bolla beettida shuchchati keeththaafe woocetti kezidi katamappe gede karen diza tuna miish yegettizason yegettana mala azazo.
Hessafe guye keeththaas soo bagga giiridi he giireththaza katamappe kare baggara tuna miish yeggizason yeggana mala azazo.
Hessafe guye kase shuchchata sohon hara ooraththa shuchchi geliin he keeththan hara ooraththa urqqay meeshetto.
«Shuchchati digettiin qasseka urqqaaka qoqofidi hara urqqan meeshi ooraththidaappe guye he hargeza malatay qasseka simmi beettiko,
qeesezi simmi biidi beyo; hargezi kaseppe gede aakki aakki biza mala gidikko he hargey issaafe issaan aadhdhiza iita harge gidida gishshas he keeththay tuna.
Hessa gishshas he keeththay laalettanaas bessees; he keeththaa shuchchay, miththaynne miishshi, urqqay wurikka katamappe gede kare tuna miishshi yegettizason yegetto.
Gordettidaappe guye he keeththan gelida asi wurikka omars gakkanaas tuna gidees.
He keeththan ichchidaadey woykko kath midaadey ba may7o meecco.

«Keeththay qasseka ooraxidi meeshettidaappe guye qeesezi yiidi xeellishin hargezi kaseppe aakki aakki bontta aggiko, hargeza malatay dhayda gishshas, he keeththay geesh gidida gishshas qeesezi keeththa aawaa eriso.
He keeththaa geeshshanaas nam7u kafo, Libaanoose ziga, zo7o xilatanne hisophphe geetettiza miththa hayth eho.
Kafotappe issaa pultto haaththi izan diza guuqa keren shukko;

hessafe guye ziga mith, hisophphe miththa hayth, zo7o xilatanne paxa diza kafoza issife gaththi ekkidi guuqa keren diza pultto haaththaninne hankko shukettida kafoza suuththan gelththi kessidi keeththaza laappunto araco.
Qeesezi hessaththo histtidi he keeththaa kafoza suuththan, pultto haaththan, paxa diza kafon, ziga miththan, hisophphe miththa hayththaninne zo7o xilatan geeshsho.
Hessafe guye paxa diza kafoza izi piradhdhi baana mala gede demba kessi yeddo; hessaththo ooththidi keeththaa geeshshiza wogaa polikko keeththayka geesh gidees.»
Hayssi ha wogazi issaafe issaan aadhdhiza galba bolla keziza ay harges, qaachcha harges,
may7o bollanne keeththa bolla issaafe issaan aadhdhi aadhdhi yiza harges,
kixa harges, badhinttessinne illiwa harges,
hayssi ay miishshika tuna woykko geesh gididayssa shaakki erisanaassinne issaafe issaan aadhdhiza iita harge woykko buuqa geeshshanaas diza woga.
